unit.label: Aqua-MODIS-scale detections per month
unit.definition: Count of satellite active-fire detections (not fires) per calendar month (UTC), daytime, filter type0_nh. Every value carries value_kind: observed (native Aqua), raw_viirs / raw_terra (native counts on their own scale, never compared directly with Aqua), converted_validated, converted_unvalidated, or unavailable.

converted_unvalidated.note: display-only: the frozen method refitted on all nominal 2018-04..2021-12 months of this region; not validated

provenance.gap_estimates: none: record is unavailable where Aqua is not observed (M3 decision D3)

notes: Record = observed Aqua only. A converted value never replaces an observed Aqua value; where Aqua is not observed the record is unavailable, never zero.
converted_validated (2018-04..2021-12) are the M2 held-out predictions, made with Aqua hidden. converted_unvalidated (2022 onward) are display-only and not validated (Aqua drifting).
n = 0 with status observed means no detections reported; FIRMS has no non-detection records.

verdict_rule.description: Compare the month's record value (with its interval when modelled) with the 10th-90th percentile of observed Aqua MODIS counts for the same calendar month in complete Aqua years 2003-2011. above: interval entirely above p90; below: entirely below p10; within: inside [p10, p90]; otherwise can't tell. Descriptive screening, not a significance test, and not a forecast.
